name: Polished By Joy
address_raw: 13145 N Dale Mabry Hwy #D 22, Tampa, FL 33618
about:
Polished by Joy offers a relaxing fume-free and dust-free environment focused on natural nail care. All services use vegan friendly and cruelty-free products that promote healthy nails without harsh chemicals or odors. Experience luxury nail care designed for your comfort, health, and peace of mind.



🌿 Products

At Polished by Joy, every product is carefully chosen with your nail health and comfort in mind.
We believe beauty should never come at the cost of your well-being — or the planet’s.

💅 What i Use
	•	Vegan & Cruelty-Free Brands – All our products are ethically sourced and never tested on animals.
	•	Fume-Free Formulas – Enjoy a clean, relaxing experience without harsh odors or toxic chemicals.
	•	Non-Acrylic Systems – We specialize in Gel X extensions and builder gel for long-lasting, natural-looking nails that protect your nail bed.
	•	Non-Toxic Nail Polish – We choose brands free from harmful ingredients like formaldehyde, toluene, and DBP.
	•	High-Quality Tools & Sanitization – Every file, brush, and buffer is sanitized or single-use to ensure the highest hygiene standards.

✨ Why It Matters

Healthy nails are beautiful nails. Our mission is to help you grow and maintain your natural nails while keeping them polished, strong, and stunning — without compromise.
